therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with recurrent or refractory glioblastoma multiforme or gliosarcoma

results.effect_size: 22/60 patients progression-free at 6 months in bevacizumab+irinotecan arm, 23/60 in bevacizumab+temozolomide arm
biomarker_changes: Changes in cerebral blood volume (rCBV) at week 2 showed AUC 0.85 for predicting 12-month OS
Standardized rCBV changes at week 16 showed AUC 0.905 for predicting 12-month OS
subgroup_findings: MRI spectroscopy ratios showed variable predictive value for survival with AUC ranging 0.39-1.0
safety_signals: Upper GI hemorrhage: 1/60 in each arm
results.dose_information: Bevacizumab given IV, irinotecan given IV, temozolomide given orally - specific doses not provided

context.duration: treatment up to 24 months, follow-up up to 62.9 months
